items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Famous Amos. Famous -- shit, here's a guy who made Chocolate Chip Cookie... [INTERVIEWEE] You're talking about a guy who did it himself, right?

ctx.x: Famous Amos. Famous -- shit, here's a guy who made Chocolate Chip Cookie, and was very astute about packaging it and selling it. He put his picture on the cover and he sells a million dollars of chocolate chip cookies.
You're talking about a guy who did it himself, right? I'm talking about people who are employed by white people.
